question: How are Agni's oblation and manifold abodes described in this invocation?
premises: Agni stretches out the oblation in heaven.
The abodes are borne in many ways.
inference: Agni extends the oblation in heaven and bears his abodes in many ways.
uncertainties: The subject of bibhṛta may be understood as addressed to attendants or worshippers.
plain_english: Agni has stretched the oblation in heaven; bear Agni's abodes in many ways.
